note_lr: Peak 3e-5, warmup 100, floor 5e-6 as r4/r5. Cosine spans the fixed 2400-update horizon, so rungs 300/900/2400 are prefixes of one trajectory. A resume without Adam state re-warms over 100 updates.
note_ema: Decay .99 instead of r5's .999: at .999 a 300-update EMA is close to a flat mean of the whole rung, including the first post-surgery updates.
note_surgery: Depth 16->8 (even pattern, keeps layers 0 and 15) plus decoder FFN 4096->1792 by unit-norm-product pruning: about 132.8M trainable parameters (40.5% of r5). Encoder FFN is untouched because apply_surgery does not support it. This is the aggressive rung; the fallback chain is ffn 2048 (~139M), then depth 12 + ffn 3072 (~208M), then C3 unchanged (~189.5M).
